title: Commit
plain: A commit is a saved snapshot of your files.
check: What does a commit save, and what does it leave out?
rubric: Says it saves the files as they are now
Says it keeps the earlier states too
try: Run `git log` to see the list of commits.
pitfall: A commit is not an upload to the internet.

title: Repository
plain: A repository is a folder that Git tracks.
check: How do you know a folder is a repository?
try: Run `git status` in your project folder.
pitfall: A repository is not the GitHub website.

title: HTML
plain: HTML is the language that describes the content of a web page.
check: Which tag holds the page title?
try: Open index.html and find the title line.
pitfall: HTML is not a programming language that computes.
